title: A visit to an aquarium
topic: A parent and child are talking at an aquarium. Where will the child wait for his mother?
levelRationale: N5-oriented polite everyday speech with simple requests, time/place expressions and explicit contrasts. Follow the announced focus rather than remembering every detail. Vocabulary tips identify potentially unfamiliar spoken words; this is not an official JLPT vocabulary or difficulty certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、質問の答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen and choose one answer to the question.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 水族館で親子が話しています。子供は、お母さんをどこで待ちますか。
turns.translation: A parent and child are talking at an aquarium. Where will the child wait for his mother?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 楽しかったね。もうすぐ帰る時間です。お母さんはちょっと手を洗ってきます。
turns.translation: That was fun. It's nearly time to go home. I'm just going to wash my hands.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: じゃ、僕は入口で待っているね。外の大きい魚の絵の前にいるよ。
turns.translation: Then I'll wait at the entrance. I'll be in front of the large fish picture outside.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 外には出ないでね。今日は人が多いから、中で待っていてください。
turns.translation: Don't go outside. There are a lot of people today, so please wait inside.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 中の売店はどう。お菓子を見ていてもいい。まだお金は持っているよ。
turns.translation: How about the shop inside? Can I look at the sweets? I still have some money.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 売店は今、閉まっています。階段の下に椅子があるでしょう。そこに座っていて。
turns.translation: The shop is closed right now. There are chairs under the stairs, aren't there? Sit there and wait.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: うん。階段の下の椅子に座って待っているよ。かばんもちゃんと持っていく。
turns.translation: Okay. I'll sit on the chair under the stairs and wait. I'll make sure to take my bag too.

options.label: 外の魚の絵の前
options.translation: Outside, in front of the fish picture.

options.label: 売店の中
options.rationale: The shop is closed; looking at sweets was only his suggestion.

options.label: 階段の下の椅子
options.rationale: His mother selects this location and he repeats it.

options.label: 手を洗う所
options.rationale: His mother goes there; he stays elsewhere.

explanation: The mother's final instruction and the child's confirmation agree. Earlier proposed locations do not become the meeting place.
